summary: LD's classify_section() matched section names exactly, so nasm's '.text.entry' section in entry.o was dropped and _start vanished from the linked kernel (isr_stub_0 landed at the entry address).
evidence: entry.o built by NASM ... names its section `.text.entry`, not `.text`, and my `classify_section()` only matched the exact string, silently dropping `_start`

summary: CC's -I option only accepted the separated form '-I dir', not the gcc-style combined '-Ikernel' used by the Makefile, so kernel headers were not found.
evidence: `CC`'s `-I` parsing only supports the separated form (`-I dir`), but the actual Makefile uses the combined form (`-Ikernel`)

summary: CC's argument parser treated any unrecognized flag (-Wall, -O2, -c, ...) as the input filename.
evidence: `CC`'s arg parser treats *any* unrecognized flag as the input filename

summary: CC preprocessor reused a static per-depth path buffer for sibling #includes while token_t.file kept a raw pointer into it, so earlier tokens' filenames were retroactively overwritten (errors reported in string.h instead of tinyfs.h).
evidence: `paths[depth]` is a static buffer reused by *every* `#include` at the same nesting depth ... `token_t.file` stores a raw pointer into it

summary: CC preprocessor expanded macros only one level deep, so macro bodies referencing other macros (TINYFS_DATA_BLOCK -> TINYFS_INODE_BLOCK) left undeclared identifiers.
evidence: The actual failure is nested macro expansion only recursing one level deep.

summary: CC's perr reported the token after the failing identifier (parser had already advanced), producing misleading 'near ?' diagnostics.
evidence: `perr` reads `p->toks[p->pos]`, but by the time `resolve_ident` calls it, the parser has already advanced past the actual failing identifier

summary: CC's host _start did a bare 'call main', so argv received argv[0]'s value instead of the address of the argv array.
evidence: `_start: call main` doesn't set up `argc`/`argv` per the Linux process-entry ABI ... `argv` receives `argv[0]`'s string-pointer value instead of the array pointer

summary: CC did not recognize 'long' as a type keyword, so mkfs_tinyfs.c's 'long offset' failed to compile.
evidence: `long` isn't a recognized type keyword in CC's dialect at all — `mkfs_tinyfs.c` uses it

summary: CC codegen called walk_collect (which recurses into ->next) on every top-level node inside a loop over ->next, quadratically duplicating string literals/externs and causing duplicate labels in AS.
evidence: the first call already walks the entire rest of the top-level chain, and then the loop re-walks the tail again on every subsequent iteration

summary: CC never allocated storage for function-local static variables (only top-level decls were scanned for .data/.bss), leaving __static_N references unresolved.
evidence: without this they'd be referenced (lea eax, [__static_N]) but never ac[tually allocated]

summary: CC emitted _start/'call main' in every --target=host translation unit, so objects without main (tinyfs.c, string.c) failed with unresolved 'main'.
evidence: `_start`/`call main` gets emitted into *every* `--target=host` compilation unit, not just the one that actually defines `main`

summary: AS parsed at most 2 operands, silently dropping the immediate of 3-operand 'imul reg, reg, imm' and encoding a self-multiply, which broke array indexing (argv[1] read garbage -> EFAULT/segfault).
evidence: `imul ecx, ecx, 4` (3-operand immediate form) is being mis-encoded as the 2-operand `imul ecx, ecx`, silently dropping the multiply-by-4 scale

summary: Toolchain test t04_pointers passed despite the broken imul encoding because writes and reads used the same wrong index formula, so the battery could not detect the bug.
evidence: It self-cancels in `t04_pointers` because both the write (`nums[i]=`) and read (`a[i]`) use the same broken formula

summary: CC codegen dereferenced a bare function name used as a value (callback argument) instead of decaying it to its address, passing 4 bytes of machine code as the function pointer.
evidence: a bare function name used as a value ... must decay to its address, not be dereferenced — it was reading 4 bytes of the function's own machine code

summary: CC always emitted a direct symbol call even when calling through a function-pointer variable (tinyfs's block_read/block_write), jumping to the variable's storage instead of the pointed-to function.
AS had no encoding for register-indirect 'call r32' (FF /2), needed by CC's new indirect-call codegen.
evidence: call r/m32 (FF /2) - indirect call through a register, e.g. a function-pointer variable's loaded value

summary: Ad-hoc pipeline verification commands printed success lines ('CC: all three compiled OK', 'AS: all three assembled OK', 'LD: linked OK', cmp 'IDENTICAL') after steps had failed, hiding the failures and confusing the diagnosis.
evidence:
ld: cannot open /tmp/mkfs_build/tinyfs.o
LD: linked OK

summary: Booting QEMU with '-serial stdio' under timeout piped to head produced no output (exit 143), so the boot check had to be redone with serial to a log file and a backgrounded QEMU.
evidence: Let me use the same pattern (serial to a log file, background QEMU) instead of `-serial stdio` under `timeout`.
